_comment: Shape of <home>/.claude/settings.json for the agent 'daedalus'. bin/new-agent prints the real paths; <memory-dir> is ~/.claude/projects/<home path with every non-alphanumeric char as '-'>/memory. Each hook line is guarded so a missing script is SAID, never silent.

hooks.command: f="$HOME/.claude/hooks/daedalus/memory-budget.py"; { [ -r "$f" ] && python3 "$f" "<memory-dir>" PostToolUse daedalus; } || printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"HOOK MISSING or failed: %s"}}\n' "$f"

f="$HOME/.claude/hooks/daedalus/memory-budget.py"; { [ -r "$f" ] && python3 "$f" "<memory-dir>" SessionStart daedalus; } || printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"HOOK MISSING or failed: %s"}}\n' "$f"

f="$HOME/.claude/hooks/daedalus/startup-injection.sh"; { [ -r "$f" ] && bash "$f" "Daedalus" "<memory-dir>" daedalus_deep_mind.md daedalus; } || printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"HOOK MISSING or failed: %s"}}\n' "$f"
hooks.statusMessage: Loading the agent template and the deep mind

hooks.command: f="$HOME/projects/fortress/bin/whois"; { [ -r "$f" ] && python3 "$f" --hook; } || printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"whois unavailable (Fortress absent at %s); peers unknown this session"}}\n' "$f"
